Metadata-protocol: none
Responsibility: `@objectstack/lint` / `@objectstack/runtime` in objectstack (an action body that cannot compile in the runtime's `(async (input, ctx) => { SOURCE })` wrapper, e.g. `const input = …`, passes validate/build/verify, then every run_action answers an opaque 500 INTERNAL_ERROR) | none | every author (human or AI) of script actions, and every MCP caller of run_action
Thread-read: 6953002073
Premise: holds at code level on origin/main fff0ad0c18. `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/quickjs-runner.ts:409` wraps an action body as `(async (input, ctx) => { SOURCE })`; an `evalCode` error is thrown as `SandboxError("action 'X' threw: …")` with no code; `packages/cli/src/utils/extract-hook-body.ts:406` notes that a code-less `SandboxError` reaches REST as `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`. No author-time check compiles the body in that wrapper. The dev reproduces the card's `const input = ctx.input || {}; return 1;` live (build exit 0, run_action 500) before code.
Serial constraints cleared: open PR #34719 (#34273, action-body refusal catalogue: spec, runtime, lint) shares the lint package; overlap-check against it and current main before every push.
Pre-claim lane: `domain:server` — seat-assigned to area o3-C (seat 3 dispatches all repo p1).
Pre-claim deps: none on the card; triage first touch 6953002073 queued it at p1.
Prior rulings read: card-named only; extract-hook-body.ts's documented action face (`LoweringFace`, #22837 hook rebind does not apply to actions); thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziunkXbDT7wUWqfmWz

Delivered by PR #34980 (merged, 743308b9): an L2 script action body that does not compile as the body of `(async (input, ctx) => { … })` is refused as `action-body-does-not-compile` (error) by `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`, `os verify` and the publish door for `action` and `object` writes. A host-refused regular-expression literal is a warning. At run time, a compile failure answers a 500 that names the action and the compiler's reason instead of the bare "Internal server error". The QuickJS runner builds its wrapper from the same `actionBodyFunctionExpression` lint compiles against. The narrowing is registered as ADR-0087 entry `action-body-does-not-compile-refused` (`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`). `pm:dispatched` and `lease:o3-C` come off with this close.

Open at the merge: nits only (seat contract review 6964237524, N1–N5; the `authoring-rules.ts` registration comment still says "only the bodies it adds" and waits for a later touch). Follow-ups: #34987 (hook and job bodies), #34988 (data-hooks.md, blocked on #34504), #35040 (an unterminated regex literal takes the warning arm). Dev-effort: high · Rounds: 2.
